adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `next`/`previous` actions compute an `offset`, immediately `group.set("offset", offset)`, then call `return group.findMembers();`. In `discourse/models/group.js`, `findMembers()` updates `members`/`user_count`/`limit`/`offset` only inside the `.then(...)` success handler and has no error handling/rollback. Therefore, if the AJAX request fails, `offset` (and thus `currentPage`/`showingFirst`/`showingLast` used by the pagination UI) will reflect the new page while `members` remains the old list, leaving the UI desynchronized exactly as described.
